correctness.rationale: The full 103-tetrahedron presentation reconstructs the published face vector. Unimodular integral reduction gives Smith data \(1^{101},2,0,0\), hence \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z^2\oplus\mathbb Z/2\). Two integral cocycles and one mod-two cocycle are checked on every facial relation and are jointly onto the proved quotient. Exhaustion of all 467 graph triangles gives 206 faces and 261 nonfaces; every nonface has nonzero exact coordinates and the seven stated unoriented multiplicities.

value.rationale: The manifold \(M_2\) is a natural Nil \(T^2\)-bundle whose first homology has both a rank-two free quotient and order-two torsion. The complete first simple-cycle layer is therefore a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. Showing that every empty triangle is essential, that all infinite-order minimizers are primitive, and that their free projections form exactly a three-direction hexagonal shell with both torsion lifts represented gives structural information not encoded by the known homology or face vector.
